summary: SuperAdmins can now delete admin accounts and import administrators safely.

new.title: Delete admin accounts
new.text: A SuperAdmin can delete an account on Admin accounts by typing DELETE. It goes through the offboard approval, and break-glass accounts are never deleted.

new.title: Import administrators from a file
new.text: Admin accounts > Import administrators shows the format and offers a template. Every line is previewed as new, overwrite, skip or invalid before anything is staged.

fixes.title: Duplicate a group more safely
fixes.text: Only group types are offered, groups are listed by name, and a name whose tag already exists is refused while you type.

fixes.title: Moving an admin between groups works reliably
fixes.text: Admins load first and are listed by name, and a destination that does not exist or already holds the admin is refused.

fixes.title: Clearer auto-disable controls
fixes.text: The "Account auto-disable date" controls change the day the account is disabled, not when its delegations expire.
